QuestInfo.name: [Mini-game] Prepare Yourself for the Mini-game Station
QuestInfo.0: #bKemdi#k, the hip hop dawg, has something to say. He's kind of an oddball, but go hear him out.
QuestInfo.1: #bKemdi#k, the hip hop dawg, has something to say. He's kind of an oddball, but go hear him out.
QuestInfo.2: #bKemdi#k, the hip hop dawg, appeared out of the blue one day to announce the grand opening of his #bMini-game Station#k, where you can play mini-games with your friends.

0.msg: STOP RIGHT THERE! I have earth-shattering news for you!

1.msg: #b(Huh? A dog?) Are... Are you talking to ME?#k

2.msg: (He blows 10 raspberries in a row. He seems to think he's beatboxing.) \r\nWill the real dawg #bKemdi#k, please play a game, please play a game, please play a game.

3.msg: (He flaps his arms and bops his head like a chicken.)\r\nYo, that's right, you heard me. Mini-games are the best!

4.msg: #bIs this some kind of hidden camera show?#k

5.msg: Naw, it's just me and my mic... Spittin' out rhymes like a conman...

6.msg: I said, spreadin' the word about mini-games, and spittin' out rhymes like a conman...

8.msg: Now let me you how it is...

9.msg: (He starts kicking his legs like he's doing the can-can.)\r\nCan-can, can you play some mini-games? Can you win some nutty nuts? For the Nut Nut Nut Nut Depot?

10.msg: C-c-c-c-come and play in the new rev-rev-revolution. I said, c-c-c-ome check out my new <Mini-game Station>.

11.msg: (He starts to do the flamenco.)\r\nAnyone over level 33 can participate! You'll get #b#i4310108# #t4310108#s! Please play! Please! Cha-cha-cha!

12.msg: Oooooooh, sorry, the station isn't open yet. I'll drop some sticky beats in your ear when it's ready.

yes.0: Patience, patience, baby!\r\n#b#e(The Mini-game Station will be available on 6/25/2014.)#k#n
